summary: PASS. The repaired DG2 candidate 23e6c0a2 is faithful to the playbook for all 26 requirements. D-071 / BE16 changes only API connection handling (an unread body closes its connection, bounded shutdown, requestTimeout, a rate-metered not-found handler). It touches no methodology text, gate criterion, sequencing, register column, i18n string or UI. A normal evidence file still uploads and downloads byte-identical with its Arabic file name, on a connection that stays keep-alive. An oversized upload is refused with the localized 413 evidence.too_large, the connection is closed at once, and nothing is stored. Static checks, 771/771 unit tests on Node 22 and 24, and 274 live API/UI assertions pass (plus the observational B0009 dom-shots probe). Every warning line in the evidence is explained. No new findings.
